say:2:1430131101:1.text: Yeah, I mean, I don't really care who they are. I just look forward to the welcome feast we have for them.
say:2:1430131101:1.source_cn: 特使？哦，特使是谁都行，我只是期待欢迎特使的晚宴。

say:3:1430131102:1.text: You don't know how many delicious dishes the village prepared to welcome them.
say:3:1430131102:1.source_cn: 你不知道，村子里这次为了欢迎他们，准备了多少好吃的！
say:3:1430131102:1.male: You don't know how many delicious dishes the village prepared to welcome them.
say:3:1430131102:1.female: You don't know how many delicious dishes the village prepared to welcome them.

say:4:1430131103:1.text: All the turkey dishes and wheat beer are enough to feed the village for an entire week!
say:4:1430131103:1.source_cn: 单是各种火鸡料理和无限量供应的小麦啤酒，就够整个村子吃一周！
